title: Accounts and Lettings Administrator
description:
Are you an organised administrator with a strong eye for detail and an interest in accounts?
Would you enjoy a varied role combining financial administration, lettings and customer service?

Juice Recruitment is delighted to be working in partnership with a well-established student lettings agency in the Bath area, as they look for an Accounts & Letting Administrator.

Working closely alongside the Accounts Manager, you will play a pivotal role in ensuring the smooth financial and administrative operation of the office, while also supporting the wider lettings process.

The successful candidate will have a strong aptitude for numbers, excellent attention to detail and a passion for delivering outstanding customer service.

Previous experience within residential lettings, student accommodation or an estate agency environment would be advantageous.

This is an office-based role.

DAY TO DAY:
- Managing a small residential lettings portfolio.
- Processing daily rent payments, supplier invoices and assisting with credit control.
- Assisting with monthly landlord payments, statements and bank reconciliations.
- Maintaining accurate financial and tenancy records using property management software.
- Supporting Right to Rent checks, deposit protection and deposit returns.
- Assisting with tenancy agreements and general lettings administration.
- Providing excellent customer service to landlords, tenants and the general public.
- Handling telephone and face-to-face enquiries, resolving queries and supporting the wider team.

WE WOULD LOVE TO SEE:
- Proven experience working in a professional office environment is essential.
- Practical experience in bookkeeping, basic accounting or financial administration.
- Excellent organisational skills with impeccable attention to detail and the ability to prioritise a varied workload.
- Strong working knowledge of Microsoft Excel, Outlook and Word.
- Experience using a CRM or property management system would be advantageous.
- An exceptional telephone manner and confidence communicating face to face.
- The ability to remain calm, empathetic and professional when working under pressure or handling complaints.
- Previous experience within residential lettings, student housing or an estate agency environment would be desirable.

AND FOR YOU:
- A salary of £28,000-£32,000 per annum, dependent on experience.
- Full-time, permanent position.
- A friendly, supportive and collaborative office environment.
- Office-based role in the Bath area.
- Working Hours: Monday: 8:45am-5:30pm, Tuesday to Thursday: 9:00am-5:30pm, Friday: 8:00am-4:30pm.
- 20 days' annual leave plus bank holidays.

Please apply today!

title: Part time Finance Assistant - 22. 5 hours per week
description:
Are you an experienced Finance Assistant searching for a new opportunity? We are looking for a Part Time Finance Assistant to join their team on a permanent basis. This role offers a great chance to be involved in essential financial processes, supporting the wider business with purchase ledger tasks, reconciliation, and basic account management. You'll be working closely with the finance team, ensuring smooth and accurate handling of transactions, all while maintaining a welcoming and professional approach. The position is office-based in Bath, perfect for someone looking to balance work and personal commitments, with a flexible, part-time schedule.

DAY TO DAY:
- Accounts payable, processing supplier invoices, using ApprovalMax, ensuring all invoices are allocated correctly, preparing invoices for approval
- Maintain the Accounts payable ledger and payment runs
- Reconcile supplier statements and resolving discrepancies, supplier onboarding and data capture
- Accounts receivable to include checking of rents, service charges, credit control, chasing payments, providing reports to Financial Controller
- Maintaining the ledger, allocating receipts, updating tenant accounts,
- Daily bank reconciliations, posting receipts and journals as needed, credit card reconciliations, tenant deposits,
- Providing reports to the team for service charge budgets using Xero, liaising with wider team re all finance queries,
- Assisting in the preparation of month-end, assisting with preparation of year-end
- Maintain an organised digital filing system, support FC with any other duties, support wider team when required

WE WOULD LOVE TO SEE:
- Previous experience as a Finance or Accounts Assistant, ideally in property or similar sector
- Knowledge of purchase ledger processes and financial reconciliations
- Confidence using accounting software, with experience in Xero being highly desirable
- Strong organisational skills and attention to detail
- Excellent communication skills and a proactive attitude
- Ability to work independently and as part of a team

AND FOR YOU:
- Benefits include competitive salary
- Flexible working hours - 5 shorter days or 3 full days
- Central Bath, modern office environment in established team

title: Property Coordinator
description:
Job Description

Allen & Harris, part of Connells Group is looking for a motivated Property Coordinator to complement our fantastic team in Bath. As our Property Coordinator you will provide property management and tenancy administration support services to branches, landlords and tenants.

Working hours: Monday-Friday, 9am-5:30pm, plus one Saturday per month, 9am-2pm, with a day off in lieu.

What's in it for you as our Property Coordinator?
- Support in training towards ARLA - NFOPP qualifications
- Industry leading training and development
- Demonstrable career ladder
- Clear opportunities to progress within Connells Group
- Collaborative, rewarding and fun environment
- Team incentives

Key responsibilities of a Property Coordinator:
- Arrange all required safety inspections and certification in line with current legislation
- Ensure routine and additional property visits and checks are carried out in the required time frame
- Liaise with contractors/outsourcing resources to ensure repair/maintenance works are carried out to a satisfactory standard and timescale and in line with guarantees/warranties
- Where possible and financially viable for the client, to claim for repair/maintenance work under insurance
- Establish whether liability for work is landlords or tenants
- Ensure that the relevant payments are instructed promptly and properly regarding contractors, deposits and landlord bills

Skills and experience required to be a successful Property Coordinator:
- Outstanding Customer Service skills
- Solid administration skills
- Resilient, positive, numerate and detail oriented
- Organised and able to prioritise workload in a faced paced environment
- Excellent verbal and written communication skills
- IT literate (MS Office, internet, email systems)

Connells Group UK is an equal opportunities employer and positively encourages applications from suitably qualified and eligible candidates regardless of , race, disability, age, sexual orientation, transgender status, religion or belief, marital status, or pregnancy and maternity.
